en: Dependent on a state that is not-a-non-condition, a state that is not-a-non-condition arises by way of root condition.
[There is] one [instance] for the root [condition] … pe … one for the non-disappearance [condition]. (The full detail applies everywhere.
A state that is not-a-non-condition is a condition, by way of root condition, for a state that is not-a-non-condition.
A state that is not-a-nutriment condition is a condition, by way of object condition, for a state that is not-a-nutriment condition. (Abbreviated. [In the detailed analysis:
one under root; two under object; two under predominance … pe … two under decisive support … pe … one under non-disappearance. (The full expansion applies everywhere.)
